Read our complete offline data safety and confidentiality pledge

TrueStep is engineered with a strict privacy-by-design architecture:

1. Zero Data Collection: Your step records, walking routes, and health goals remain strictly on your local device. There are no remote servers, analytics databases, or advertising trackers.

2. Health Connect Access: TrueStep only requests read permission for steps from Health Connect to display combined daily activity. TrueStep never writes or alters your Health Connect records.

3. Hardware Sensor Usage: Daily step counting is processed directly via your phone's hardware step counter sensor with zero location tracking.

4. Optional GPS: Location permissions are only used if you explicitly start an outdoor walk session with GPS enabled. Location coordinates are kept solely in memory during the walk and never uploaded.

5. Full Data Ownership: You can export your entire step history at any time as CSV or JSON, or permanently delete all local data with a single tap.
